title: SysML 1.x Block Definition Diagram (BDD) Pump System
description: Cameo/MagicDraw XMI 2.5 Block Definition Diagram modeling a centrifugal coolant pump assembly composed of an electric drive motor, impeller, and housing with typed value properties.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xmi:XMI xmi:version="2.5"
  xmlns:xmi="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20131001"
  xmlns:uml="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001"
  xmlns:sysml="http://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/20181001/SysML">
  <uml:Model xmi:id="m_pump_bdd" name="CoolantPumpBDD">
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_pump_sys" name="CoolantPumpAssembly">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="part_motor" name="driveMotor" type="blk_motor" aggregation="composite"/>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="part_impeller" name="impeller" type="blk_impeller" aggregation="composite"/>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="val_flow" name="nominalFlowLpm">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_motor" name="BrushlessDriveMotor">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="val_voltage" name="ratedVoltageV">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="val_rpm" name="maxSpeedRpm">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_impeller" name="CentrifugalImpeller">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="val_dia" name="outerDiameterMm">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
  </uml:Model>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_pump_sys" base_Class="blk_pump_sys"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_motor" base_Class="blk_motor"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_impeller" base_Class="blk_impeller"/>
</xmi:XMI>

      </ownedAttribute>

title: Brake-by-Wire Requirements with Satisfy & Verify Traceability
description: SysML 1.x requirements traceability model linking ISO 26262 brake-by-wire safety requirements to satisfying controller blocks and verifying hardware-in-the-loop test cases.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xmi:XMI xmi:version="2.5"
  xmlns:xmi="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20131001"
  xmlns:uml="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001"
  xmlns:sysml="http://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/20181001/SysML">
  <uml:Model xmi:id="m_brake_reqs" name="BrakeByWireTraceability">
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_ecu" name="BrakeControllerECU">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="p_latency" name="actuationLatencyMs">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_caliper" name="ElectroMechanicalCaliper">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="p_clamp" name="maxClampForceKN">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="tc_latency" name="HIL_LatencyTestCase"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="tc_force" name="Dyno_ClampForceTestCase"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="req_lat" name="BrakeLatencyRequirement"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="req_force" name="BrakeForceRequirement"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_sat_lat" client="blk_ecu" supplier="req_lat"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_ver_lat" client="tc_latency" supplier="req_lat"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_sat_force" client="blk_caliper" supplier="req_force"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_ver_force" client="tc_force" supplier="req_force"/>
  </uml:Model>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_ecu" base_Class="blk_ecu"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_caliper" base_Class="blk_caliper"/>
  <sysml:Requirement xmi:id="st_req_lat" base_Class="req_lat" id="BBW-REQ-001" text="End-to-end brake actuation latency shall not exceed 15 ms."/>
  <sysml:Requirement xmi:id="st_req_force" base_Class="req_force" id="BBW-REQ-002" text="Each front caliper shall deliver at least 42 kN clamping force."/>
  <sysml:Satisfy xmi:id="st_sat_lat" base_Abstraction="abs_sat_lat"/>
  <sysml:Verify xmi:id="st_ver_lat" base_Abstraction="abs_ver_lat"/>
  <sysml:Satisfy xmi:id="st_sat_force" base_Abstraction="abs_sat_force"/>
  <sysml:Verify xmi:id="st_ver_force" base_Abstraction="abs_ver_force"/>
</xmi:XMI>

title: UAV Flight Control Architecture with SysML Profile Library
description: Multi-file MagicDraw XMI workspace combining a UAV flight-control architecture model with a companion reusable avionics profile XMI defining flight-critical stereotypes and requirements.
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xmi:XMI xmi:version="2.5"
  xmlns:xmi="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20131001"
  xmlns:uml="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001"
  xmlns:sysml="http://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/20181001/SysML">
  <uml:Model xmi:id="m_uav_fcs" name="UAVFlightControlSystem">
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_uav" name="AutonomousUAV">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="part_fcc" name="flightComputer" type="blk_fcc" aggregation="composite"/>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="part_imu" name="imuSensor" type="blk_imu" aggregation="composite"/>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_fcc" name="FlightControlComputer">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="p_loop_hz" name="controlRateHz">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="blk_imu" name="InertialMeasurementUnit">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="p_gyro_bias" name="gyroBiasDegPerHr">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="tc_fcs_sil" name="SIL_AttitudeStabilityTest"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="req_fcs_rate" name="ControlLoopRateRequirement"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_uav_sat" client="blk_fcc" supplier="req_fcs_rate"/>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Abstraction" xmi:id="abs_uav_ver" client="tc_fcs_sil" supplier="req_fcs_rate"/>
  </uml:Model>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_uav" base_Class="blk_uav"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_fcc" base_Class="blk_fcc"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_imu" base_Class="blk_imu"/>
  <sysml:Requirement xmi:id="st_req_fcs" base_Class="req_fcs_rate" id="UAV-FCS-101" text="Inner-loop attitude controller shall execute at >= 400 Hz."/>
  <sysml:Satisfy xmi:id="st_uav_sat" base_Abstraction="abs_uav_sat"/>
  <sysml:Verify xmi:id="st_uav_ver" base_Abstraction="abs_uav_ver"/>
</xmi:XMI>

title: Electric Vehicle Multi-Viewpoint Cameo System Model
description: Multi-file MagicDraw/Cameo MBSE architecture decomposing an 800V electric vehicle into system blocks (ev_system.mdxml), safety requirements (requirements.mdxml), and shared value types (types_lib.xmi).
code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xmi:XMI xmi:version="2.5"
  xmlns:xmi="http://www.omg.org/spec/XMI/20131001"
  xmlns:uml="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001"
  xmlns:sysml="http://www.omg.org/spec/SysML/20181001/SysML">
  <uml:Model xmi:id="m_ev_system" name="EVPowertrainArchitecture">
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="ev_vehicle" name="ElectricVehicle800V">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_p_pack" name="batteryPack" type="ev_pack" aggregation="composite"/>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_p_inv" name="sicInverter" type="ev_inv" aggregation="composite"/>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_bus_v_out" name="packBusVoltageV">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_inv_v_in" name="inverterDcLinkV">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
      <ownedConnector xmi:type="uml:Connector" xmi:id="ev_hv_bus" name="hvDcBusLink">
        <end xmi:id="ev_end_1" role="ev_bus_v_out"/>
        <end xmi:id="ev_end_2" role="ev_inv_v_in"/>
      </ownedConnector>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="ev_pack" name="BatteryPack800V">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_kwh" name="energyCapacityKwh">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
    <packagedElement xmi:type="uml:Class" xmi:id="ev_inv" name="SiCTractionInverter">
      <ownedAttribute xmi:type="uml:Property" xmi:id="ev_eff" name="peakEfficiencyPct">
        <type href="http://www.omg.org/spec/UML/20131001/PrimitiveTypes.xmi#Real"/>
      </ownedAttribute>
    </packagedElement>
  </uml:Model>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_ev_veh" base_Class="ev_vehicle"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_ev_pack" base_Class="ev_pack"/>
  <sysml:Block xmi:id="st_ev_inv" base_Class="ev_inv"/>
  <sysml:BindingConnector xmi:id="st_ev_hv" base_Connector="ev_hv_bus"/>
</xmi:XMI>
